title: Fix post-login infinite loading and ensure calendar + chat main screen renders after splash

requirements.text: Fix the post-login navigation/loading flow so that after the user logs in and proceeds past the splash page, the app renders the main calendar + chat screen instead of getting stuck on a full-screen "Loading..." spinner.

quotes: Once I log in past the splash page, all I get is a loading screen
1)The main screen of calendar and chat

acceptanceCriteria: After a successful Internet Identity login and proceeding past the splash page, the user sees the main screen containing the calendar and the group chat (as currently shown on the Calendar page) without an infinite loading spinner.
The app no longer blocks indefinitely on the full-screen loader in AuthGate.
Manual refresh is not required to reach the main calendar + chat screen.

requirements.text: Add explicit, user-visible error handling for the authentication gate so that if profile initialization (current user profile fetch) or actor initialization fails or stalls, the UI shows an English error state with a clear recovery action (e.g., retry and/or reload) instead of silently remaining on the loading screen.
acceptanceCriteria: If actor/profile initialization cannot complete, the user sees an English error message on screen (not only in console).
The error state provides a working recovery action (at minimum: a Retry button that re-attempts initialization, or a Reload button).
In normal conditions, the error state does not appear and the main calendar + chat screen loads as expected.

constraints: Do not edit any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x) or frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts (they are immutable paths). Implement fixes by changing usage patterns and UI behavior in editable components (e.g., frontend/src/App.tsx and/or pages/components).
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Redesigning the calendar/chat UI layout beyond what is necessary to unblock rendering after login.
Adding new authentication providers or changing Internet Identity behavior/implementation (only its usage in the app may be adjusted).
Implementing real-time chat via websockets (not supported).
